title: Router keeps its own copy of the workspace's pane names
body:
`Router.panes: Vec<String>` in `channel.rs` duplicates the names in `Workspace.tabs[..].layout.panes`. Every pane add or remove calls `router.add_pane` or `router.remove_pane` beside the real change, at five sites across `workspace.rs` and `compositor.rs`, and the `panes` reply comes back in insertion order rather than layout order.

## Proposal

`Router` holds only clients. `handle`, or the typed methods from "The MCP door reaches the router through wire text under a fake client", take the workspace's pane names as an argument. `remove_pane` keeps only the part that clears clients' claims. A borrow split between `workspace.router` and `workspace.tabs` is needed.
